entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer service. Please hold while I connect you with an agent.
Ugh, finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return something.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex, how can I help you today?
Yeah, hi Alex. I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. It's just not working out for me.
Okay, I understand. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order. Okay, I see here you purchased the VeloBand Pulse on [date of purchase, 15 days prior to call].
Yeah, that's right. So can I just get a refund?
I've reviewed our return policy, and unfortunately, the return window for the VeloBand Pulse is 10 days from the date of purchase. Since it's been 15 days, I'm unable to process a full refund.
What?! That's ridiculous! I didn't see anything about a 10-day limit. I want to speak to a manager!

I understand your frustration, and I apologize for the inconvenience. While I can’t override the return policy, I can offer you store credit for the value of the VeloBand Pulse. Would that be acceptable?
Store credit? I guess that's better than nothing. I really wanted my money back though. Is there absolutely nothing else you can do? Maybe a policy exception in this case?

I've reviewed your purchase history and while I wish I could make a policy exception, the 10-day limit is firm. I do apologize again. However, the store credit will allow you to purchase another item from our store that may better fit your needs.
Alright, fine. Store credit it is. How does that work?

Great. I can issue a store credit to your account right now for the full purchase price of the VeloBand Pulse. It will be automatically applied at checkout the next time you make a purchase on our website or in our stores. You will receive an email with a confirmation code.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks for your help, Alex. I appreciate you trying to work with me.
You're very welcome! Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
